purpose: Audit and recovery record for B.Tech course records removed from Supabase because the repository's verified, mapped syllabus PDF sources were insufficient for complete PDF-text-to-JSON conversion.

source_check.finding: Nine B.Tech course records lacked a complete mapped subject-level PDF set: eight had zero mapped PDF assets, and Mechanical Engineering AI/ML had only one mapped subject PDF for 38 listed subjects.

database_action.note: Each removed course includes its child subject IDs, names, and semester numbers in this JSON so the catalog data can be restored if needed.
